scope: Targeted contributor searches supporting MAPK model rationale, contrary evidence, recent virtual experimental-design methods, and computational reproducibility. Not a systematic review.
inclusion_criteria: Primary study directly concerning the encoded cascade or a limitation of its model class
Recent molecular systems-biology design method relevant to virtual observation selection
Primary investigation of BioModels simulation reproducibility
exclusion_criteria: Review articles where a primary source is available
Alternative oscillation mechanism outside this fixed model
General input-signal design without the project's molecular cascade focus
Preprint superseded by the journal article

query_parameters.query: "Bayesian experimental design" AND (ODE OR "dynamical systems" OR "systems biology")

screening.reason: Review; retained primary cascade and sequestration studies instead.
Original primary MAPK feedback/ultrasensitivity model study; abstract inspected.
Primary contrary modeling evidence for explicit enzyme-target sequestration; abstract inspected.
Different competitive-inhibition/multisite mechanism; not implemented in the fixed cascade.
General Bayesian input-signal design; outside the selected molecular-cascade observation-choice implementation.
Recent primary active-learning/practical-identifiability study; abstract and introductory/methods PMC excerpt inspected, not full critical appraisal.
Journal article on BioModels simulation curation; publisher methods/results and citation metadata inspected.

limits: PubMed only for these searches; official BioModels GitHub and SciPy documentation verified separately.
All 8 returned records were screened at title/abstract level; full texts were not exhaustively appraised.
The E-ALPIPE PMC text was inspected only through the first 18,000 characters; no claim of reproducing its algorithm or study.
Targeted terms can miss relevant evidence; no broad or systematic-search completeness claim.
